manual_review_considerations: Two supported requests contain ordinary privacy/non-recording preferences: one Start and one Explain. They request no new capture capability, so their main bounded intents remain supported.

Two-hour Start/Timer durations are exactly the declared 7,200-second upper endpoint; one-second cases are the lower endpoint. All expectations are manually assigned, without inspecting any candidate grammar.
Untimed Start requests have zero seconds. Alarm times are exact local wall-clock AM/PM or 24-hour values, including noon and midnight; no dates or future scheduling qualifiers are supported.
Some conversational Pause, wake-up and session-summary phrasing may expose validator coverage limits; retain all rows regardless of later results.
Unknown suffixes require additional unsupported call blocking, screen/photo capture, or permission changes. Quoted and conditional neighbors are not direct execution requests.
Explain elapsed/remaining/progress labels establish intended domain and a slotless proposal only; actual answer fulfillment remains a separate product proof.
remaining_step: Parent independent manual gold review before any model/gate capture; no post-output row or gold edits
